deepdive.thesis: Flomic Global Logistics operates a lean, asset-light 3PL model focused on freight forwarding and warehousing for SMEs in India. Its credit profile reflects modest scale and stable but limited financial buffers, with a BBB- rating indicating moderate credit risk.
